name: cardiac_segmentation
description: A medical imaging benchmark for pixel-level segmentation of cardiac structures (e.g., chambers, myocardium) from cardiac imaging modalities. Measures how accurately models delineate anatomical regions across images and supports development of automated clinical measurement pipelines. Metrics and examples are geared toward clinical segmentation quality and robustness.
reputation: A domain-specific medical imaging dataset with interest from the medical imaging research community but limited mainstream adoption outside that field.
